instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Life insurance and retirement savings provider managing €800M in mathematical provisions. Traditional with-profits and unit-linked products distributed through bancassurance partnerships with 3 retail banks. Exploring digital onboarding and needs-analysis tools for bank branch advisors. Operate from 2-3 locations or departments. We have some budget headroom for experimentation but look for quick wins that can demonstrate value within 6 months before committing to longer-term programs. The leadership team is aligned on the need to modernize but debates where to start.
answers.pastInitiatives: We operate an internal venture studio model where cross-functional teams pitch innovation ideas to an investment committee quarterly. Approved projects receive 6 months of funded incubation with dedicated resources. Our current portfolio includes 4 active projects across new business models, digital products, and operational AI use cases. One incubated project has already graduated to become a standalone business unit.
answers.strategicGoals: The board has challenged us to improve EBITDA margins by 500 basis points within 3 years. This requires a disciplined, data-driven approach to identifying cost drivers and process bottlenecks. We are open to technology investment if it demonstrably reduces unit costs or eliminates manual touchpoints, but every project must have a clear ROI timeline of under 12 months.
answers.teamSize: The innovation function is informal — one senior engineer has been given permission to spend 20% of their time exploring new technologies and prototyping ideas, but this allocation is frequently interrupted by production incidents and urgent feature requests. We have no dedicated innovation budget beyond standard cloud infrastructure costs.

input.changes_since_last: Product launch successful — 8 new features shipped. Customer NPS improved 15 points. Backlog of technical debt growing.

opportunities.title: Establish Process Efficiency Playbook for Unit Cost Reduction
opportunities.rationale: The board demands 500 bps EBITDA improvement, pointing to process bottlenecks and cost drivers. This opportunity formalizes the knowledge gained from successful product launches into repeatable operational protocols, moving beyond ad-hoc improvements.

first_actions: Map out 3 high-volume/manual processes (e.g., claims processing, KYC checks) to identify manual touchpoints and waste.
Develop a standardized 'Efficiency Impact Scorecard' used by the incubation committee for all new projects.
Pilot process automation on one identified low-risk bottleneck area in collaboration with Operations.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction of average processing time for target bottleneck process by 15%.
milestones: Completion of Process Map and Bottleneck Inventory (Month 2)
Successful pilot implementation in a sandbox environment (Month 4)
Presentation of cost-saving ROI model to leadership team (Month 6)

opportunities.title: Implement Generative AI for Advisory Needs Analysis and Underwriting Support
opportunities.rationale: To achieve 'bold' growth in a competitive market, Beacon must radically modernize its advisory tools. Integrating GenAI into the initial needs-analysis phase (bancassurance) can dramatically improve efficiency and customer experience, directly addressing the cost reduction mandate.

first_actions: Conduct legal/compliance assessment regarding AI use in financial advice and data handling (Crucial first step).
Build a secure Minimum Viable Product (MVP) prototype that ingests anonymized customer profiles and generates suggested product bundles.
Test MVP with 2-3 bank partner advisors to validate accuracy and usability.
resources_needed: Deep domain expertise from underwriting/product teams
execution_plan.success_metric: Demonstrable 20% reduction in advisor time spent on initial needs assessment.
milestones: Alpha testing phase completion with internal team (Month 3)
Pilot deployment with external partner bank (Month 6)

next_steps.action: Establish a dedicated 'Innovation Resource Guardrail' to protect the 20% capacity of key engineers from BAU production incident interruptions.
Form a cross-functional working group (Finance, Product, Operations) chartered solely with quantifying the cost associated with technical debt and process bottlenecks.
Re-calibrate the Venture Studio committee charter to mandate a clear, measurable ROI timeline (<12 months) and an ownership owner for all projects graduating into standalone units.

key_weaknesses: Innovation capacity is highly vulnerable to BAU 'firefighting,' preventing deep focus on strategic initiatives.
The definition of process efficiency improvements remains tactical; they need a formalized, quantitative playbook linked directly to EBITDA goals.
Governance structure (Venture Studio) requires stricter enforcement of ROI timelines and clear resource handoffs post-incubation.

improvements: Successfully launched 8 new features, demonstrating improved technical velocity and product market fit.
Achieved a significant 15-point improvement in Customer NPS, indicating effective customer feedback loops are working.
persistent_gaps: Lack of dedicated innovation budget beyond standard cloud costs prevents rapid scaling or aggressive prototyping outside of the studio model.
The core bottleneck remains resource allocation; high operational demand consistently trumps strategic experimentation time.
achieved_milestones: Validation of increased customer satisfaction (NPS) and product functionality.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Shift from a foundational assessment (formal structure) to an operational challenge phase. Success in product delivery is noted, but growth is now constrained by technical debt and the need for deep process efficiency gains to meet aggressive EBITDA targets.
